title: 第二十一章 地脉真解第二十二章 葛晖死了
lines: 秋去冬至，寒冷降临。
院子里。
林砚赤裸着上身，整个脊柱犹如一把大弓，汗水从肩胛滚落，沿着起伏的背肌滑下，皮肤像被反复锻打的铁胚，泛着内敛的韧泽。
吁！
他一口气吐出，在冷空气之下迅速化作寒雾，足足射出一尺方才消散。
他体内的武道树，已经来到了一尺七寸，离着二次磨皮武者的两尺高度相差不多了。
这修炼速度已经远超大部分一次磨皮武者。
而能够保持这般速度，其一是因为劈山拳已经接近小成，大部分武者在一次磨皮期间，能够将功法修炼到精通已经很不错了。
其二就是石腰蛮脊根骨带来的气血滋长的加成。
没有这两样，以武馆那些师兄正常修炼速度，差不多要两年才能达到二次磨皮关卡。
若是冲关失败，又得耽误个一年半载。
好在自己不存在冲关失败的风险，目前的麻烦就是他人赞助的银钱花光了，现在还能维持着壮肌膏，全赖唐家的例钱支撑着。
“林爷，给您擦脸。”
一旁的阿秀，早就备好了水盆，将脸巾拧好递过来。
“多谢。”
林砚接过脸巾擦掉脸上的汗，至于身上的汗倒是没去管，刚开始阿秀几次提过替他擦拭，但被他给拒绝了。
不是不适应陌生人给自己擦身体，前世活了三十五岁，也不是没享受过擦拭身体的服务，698的玩不起，398更有性价比的。
只是现在自己正是奋斗之时，不能养成享受的习惯。
林砚擦拭完说道：“明后两天不用来了。”
接过毛巾的阿秀一怔，林砚又补充了一句：“今日我要回县城一趟，明后两天都不在。”
这三个月，林砚每月回城一次，傍晚出发，在家中住上一晚，第二天清早又赶回到镇上，虽然郑勋说过东家不会在意这些，但拿人钱财，林砚不想落人口实。
唐家挂职是一份好工作，他不想丢掉。
而现在入冬时节，药田大部分都已经收割了，少数还种植的也远没到收成的时候，不用每天都在这里盯着。
“林砚，走了。”
等到林砚收拾好走出院门，郑勋已经是在等候了。
在青田镇这三个月，林砚和郑勋关系处得不错，两人年龄相仿，而其他人都比两人大上一轮，用郑勋的话说，和这些人聊不到一块去。
两人进了城，郑勋便是朝着林砚挤眉弄眼：“林砚，真不跟我去潇洒一番？”
“不了。”
回城的一路上，郑勋彻底放飞了，一路与林砚讲述着城中勾栏女子的美妙滋味，不断的诱惑着林砚，不过林砚却是不为所动。
虽说武者磨皮之后，已经不用太忌讳酒色，可今日郑勋请了自己，来日自己是否要回请？
郑勋和自己情况不一样，郑家虽然比不上城中那些顶尖家族，可郑勋的祖父生前也是三次磨皮武者，积攒了不菲的家底，他有这本钱去潇洒。
自己身上的钱练武都不够，怎么可能会花在这上面。
人处低谷之时，尽量减少玩乐社交，即便是有人请客，花人家的钱，那少不得也要奉承讨好几句，久而久之便是默认了自己不如他人的身份地位，丧失奋斗之志。
与郑勋分离，林砚先是去武馆买了一坛壮肌膏，而后朝着自己家里走去，和三个月前相比，现在的北城区域气氛明显不同，街上行走的人少了，就连以往成群的小孩子们，也都消失不见了。
“婶婶，我回来了。”
content_en:
Autumn passes and winter solstice comes, and the cold comes.
yard.
Lin Yan's upper body was naked, and his entire spine was like a big bow. Sweat rolled off his shoulder blades and slid down along the undulating back muscles. His skin was like an iron embryo that had been forged repeatedly, glowing with restrained toughness.
Call!
He exhaled in one breath, which quickly turned into cold mist under the cold air, and shot out for a full foot before dissipating.
The martial arts tree in his body has reached one foot and seven inches, which is almost the same as the two feet height of the second-time skin resurfacing warrior.
This cultivation speed has far surpassed most of the one-time skin-grinding warriors.
The reason for being able to maintain such a speed is that Splitting Mountain Fist is close to a minor success. Most warriors can practice the technique to proficiency during a single skinning period, which is already very good.
The second is the bonus of Qi and blood growth brought by the stone waist backbone.
Without these two things, based on the normal training speed of the martial arts brothers, it would take almost two years to reach the second level of skin resurfacing.
If the application fails, it will be delayed for another year and a half.
Fortunately, there is no risk of failure in passing the customs clearance. The current trouble is that the money sponsored by others has been spent. Now I can still maintain the muscle strengthening cream, all thanks to the support of the Tang family's regular money.
"Master Lin, wipe your face."
Axiu on the side had already prepared a basin, twisted the face towel and handed it over.
"Thank you."
Lin Yan took the face towel and wiped the sweat off his face. As for the sweat on his body, he didn't care. At first, Axiu offered to wipe it for him several times, but he refused.
It's not that I'm not used to strangers wiping my body. I lived thirty-five years old in my previous life, and it's not that I haven't enjoyed the service of wiping my body. 698 can't afford it, and 398 is more cost-effective.
It's just that now that I'm struggling, I can't develop the habit of enjoying myself.
Lin Yan finished wiping and said, "I won't be here for the next two days."
A Xiu was startled after taking the towel, and Lin Yan added: "I have to go back to the county town today, and I won't be here for the next two days."
In the past three months, Lin Yan returned to the city once a month. He set out in the evening, stayed at home for one night, and rushed back to the town early the next morning. Although Zheng Xun said that his employer would not care about this, Lin Yan did not want to live up to his words when taking people's money.
The Tang family's temporary job was a good job, and he didn't want to lose it.
Now that it is winter, most of the medicinal fields have been harvested, and the few that are still planted are far from harvest time, so there is no need to keep an eye on them here every day.
"Lin Yan, let's go."
By the time Lin Yan packed up and walked out of the courtyard, Zheng Xun was already waiting.
In the past three months in Qingtian Town, Lin Yan and Zheng Xun had a good relationship. The two were similar in age, and the others were all a bit older than them. In Zheng Xun's words, it was impossible to talk to these people.
When the two entered the city, Zheng Xun winked at Lin Yan and said, "Lin Yan, you really don't want to come with me to have some fun?"
"No."
On the way back to the city, Zheng Xun was completely lethargic. He told Lin Yan about the wonderful taste of the women in the city, constantly tempting Lin Yan, but Lin Yan was unmoved.
Although warriors no longer need to be too taboo about drinking and sex after polishing their skin, Zheng Xun invited me today. Will I want to return the invitation in the future?
Zheng Xun's situation is different from his own. Although the Zheng family is not as good as the top families in the city, Zheng Xun's grandfather was also a skin-scaling warrior three times during his lifetime and accumulated a lot of wealth. He has the money to live in style.
I don't have enough money to practice martial arts, so how could I spend it on this?
When people are at a low point, they should try to minimize fun and socializing. Even if someone treats someone and spends their money, they must flatter you. Over time, they will acquiesce that they are inferior to others and lose their ambition to strive.
After separating from Zheng Xun, Lin Yan first went to the martial arts school to buy a jar of muscle-strengthening ointment, and then walked towards his home. Compared with three months ago, the atmosphere in Beicheng area is obviously different now. There are fewer people walking on the street, and even the groups of children in the past have disappeared.
"Auntie, I'm back."
